decision: Do not repeat the same hosted topology or change application protection checks to chase this result. No reviewed public Apple source supplies a supported nonphysical Complete-enabling configuration or explains this exact EINVAL. An Apple code-level support question is now better founded than further speculative mutation/instrumentation. This is not proof that every Simulator/VM is incapable.

h03_input.provenance: Root and protection_volume supplied actual facts; raw audit belongs to the other reviewers, not this documentation review.
h03_input.facts: Native macOS15.7.9 public setter FALSE; Cocoa256 -> POSIX22 (EINVAL), chain termination no-underlying. Same owned inode stays class3; APFS support advertisement false and MNT_CPROTECT clear.
h03_input.inference_boundary: This is Foundation's reported error, not an observed failing syscall. It does not identify open, fcntl, framework argument validation, missing hardware/keybag service, or an exclusive cause. A native macOS process may still run in a VM. SDK26.2 is not host OS26.2.

quotes: On a Mac with Apple silicon, Data Protection defaults to Class C (see Data Protection classes) but uses a volume key rather than a per-extent or per-file key—effectively re-creating the security model of FileVault for user data.
Developers can also opt in to a higher protection class that uses a per-file or per-extent key.
authoritative_platform_evidence.meaning: Positive general Apple-silicon Mac feature support; not a promise for virtual guests/disposable images. The intervening macOS26.4 FileVault-default statement is not an evidenced remedy for host15.7.9 or a substitute for per-file Complete.

authoritative_platform_evidence.quote: Volumes that use per-file encryption require hardware encryption, and the steps below describe only software encryption.
authoritative_platform_evidence.meaning: Peer-fetched PDF hash and retained page extract rechecked here. Authoritative dated architecture prerequisite, not proof of current VM hardware exposure or the installed failure site. It supplies no software-only disk-image recipe for Complete. Detailed filesystem feasibility is protection_volume's separate review.

simulator_documentation_check.scope: Testing and Debugging in Simulator; updated2018-02-15, explicitly deprecated in Xcode9; hardware list explicitly as of iOS8.2.
simulator_documentation_check.finding: Reparsed the complete retained HTML, including full Hardware Differences and API Differences lists: zero occurrences of protect. It does NOT explicitly list Data Protection as unavailable. Do not invent that quotation or apply unrelated historical limitations to current Simulator/native macOS. No new current Simulator exclusion was found.

virtualization.finding: Official macOS VM setup/run sample; no affirmative per-file Data Protection configuration found.

Documented platform properties are auxiliaryStorage, hardwareModel, machineIdentifier; page contains no Data Protection/Secure Enclave promise. Absence in these two pages is not an exhaustive virtualization support matrix.

supported_next_step.basis: Apple offers program members code-level support for frameworks/APIs/tools, requests one discrete issue, specific expected outcome, exact hardware/OS conditions and a minimal reproducer. Its Feedback Assistant guidance says technical support engineers can investigate possible workarounds.
supported_next_step.question: Does NSFileManager setting NSFileProtectionComplete support a native arm64 macOS15.7.9 hosted VM whose APFS volume reports no file-protection capability, and is FALSE/Cocoa256 with underlying POSIX22 expected? If this configuration cannot supply Complete, what documented supported nonphysical configuration, if any, can?
supported_next_step.minimal_packet: Existing owned synthetic public-API reproducer only; normalized return/error chain, same-inode before/after classes, filesystem capability masks, and exact retained host/build/SDK/Foundation identity. Distinguish observations from proposed causes. Do not send private app data, paths, keybags, credentials, or broad terminal transcripts.
supported_next_step.submission: Prepared recommendation only. No ticket, forum post, private source upload, diagnostic profile, sysdiagnose collection, or Apple account action performed; owner authorization required.

qualification: A documented general Apple-silicon feature is not qualification of a specific self-hosted host, VM, Simulator or production app. A bare-metal candidate would require scope approval and its own evidence, not be silently reclassified as nonphysical. All strict historical failures remain failures; no class3/capabilityfalse/collection success equivalence to Complete.
activity: Retained source/evidence reads and bounded public Apple GETs only. Only this report and compact new support excerpts written. No source/Git edits, builds/tests, CI, native probes, mounts, resource mutation, cloned repositories, child agents or notifications.
